{{TOC|side}}
An '''expression''' is a piece of code that returns a value.


== Expression Types ==

An expression can be:

* [[Variables|variable]]
* [[Operators|operation]]
* [[:Category:Scripting Commands|scripting command]]
* [[Control Structures|control structure]]

=== Variable ===

An expression can be a simple [[Variables|variable]] ([[identifier]]):

'''Examples:'''

<sqs>
_myVariable
globalVariable
</sqs>

=== Operation ===

An expression can be an [[Operators|operation]] including its [[Operand|operands]].

'''Examples:'''

<sqs>
5 * 6
a % 2
b * c
</sqs>

=== Scripting Command ===

An expression can be a scripting command returning a value including its [[Argument|arguments]].

'''Examples:'''

<sqs>
count myArray
position unit1
</sqs>

=== Control Structure ===

An expression can be a [[Control Structures|control structure]] returning a value.

'''Examples:'''

<sqs>
; returns myValueA or myValueB
if (myCondition) then { myValueA } else { myValueB }
</sqs>
